name: Claymark
description: A Markdown reader and editor built for streamed, untrusted LLM output. Offline, private, sandboxed.

open-full-tab.description: Open Claymark in a new tab

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; object-src 'none'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'none'; frame-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
content_security_policy.sandbox: sandbox allow-scripts; default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data:; font-src data:; connect-src 'none'
